messages:
Avery (CEO): Quick announce — town hall next Tuesday 10:00am PT. Please drop any questions here by EOD Friday so we can prioritize the Q&A. Recording will be posted after.

Priya (VP Product): Planning to demo the new routing policy UI + rollout plan. Need ~7 mins for demo + 10 for Qs.

Sam (Eng Mgr): Can we include a short slide on Dedicated GA pricing/commit tiers? I'll sync with Riley to confirm numbers.

Riley (Finance): Yup, I can pull the committed tier examples and estimated unit economics — will drop in a doc.

Marta (SRE): I can cover the March 7th outage root cause and the follow-ups (deploy gating + canary policy). 5–8 min slot?

Jules (People Ops): We'll enable an anonymous form for questions for anyone who prefers that. Link below once it's live. Also reminder: we’ll have a short pulse survey after the town hall.

ops-bot: Reminder set: Town Hall • Tue 10:00am PT — calendar invite sent to all-hands. Recording enabled.

Avery (CEO): Proposed agenda (feel free to edit):

```
Agenda:\n1) Exec update — company focus and hires (Avery) — 10m
2) Product roadmap + demo (Priya) — 20m
3) Dedicated GA launch plan (Sam + Riley) — 10m
4) Reliability recap + learnings (Marta) — 8m
5) Ops & support changes (Jules) — 5m
6) Live Q&A (all) — 12m
```

Priya (VP Product): Suggest adding a 3-min note on Optimize recommendations & cost controls for customers — lots of PMs asked for that.

Sam (Eng Mgr): Also proposing a single slide with traffic expectations and fallback policies for the GA announcement.

Jules (People Ops): Anonymous Q form: https://forms.internal/redd-townhall-q (placeholder — will post final link) :memo: 

Avery (CEO): Please react with :raised_hands: if you want to present or add an agenda item. If no reaction, we'll assume the above covers it.

Marta (SRE): :raised_hands: I'll present the incident recap.

Riley (Finance): I'll join for the GA pricing piece.

Sam (Eng Mgr): :thumbsup: I'll take the GA rollout slides.

Avery (CEO): Last call for questions — drop them here or in the anonymous form. Will post the recording and a short writeup afterward with key takeaways and action items. Thanks all.
